Amin Milani Fard

Associate Professor; Computer Science, College of Engineering & Computing Sciences

Education Credentials: Ph.D.

Expertise: Software Analysis, Software Engineering, Security and Privacy, Data Mining, Machine Learning

Joined New York Tech: 2018

Amin Milani Fard is an Associate Professor of Computer Science at New York Institute of Technology – Vancouver Campus. He obtained his Ph.D. in Computer Software Engineering from the University of British Columbia, and his M.Sc. in Computer Science from Simon Fraser University.

  • Data Centre Security
  • Secure Software Engineering
  • Data Mining
  • Algorithm Concepts
  • Topics in Computer Security
  • Hacker Exploit and Intrusion Detection
  • Data Structures
  • Programming
  • Project I
  • Project II

Contact Information

Phone: 555.555.0100

Office: Vancouver, BC

Website: https://aminmf.github.io/
